Fits the 10-dimensional SIW hierarchical psychometric model
```{r}
library(rstan)
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Task definitions
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
all_tasks  <- c(perc_tasks, cog_tasks)
n_perc_task <- length(perc_tasks)
n_cog_task  <- length(cog_tasks)
n_task      <- length(all_tasks)

# Process perception data
perc_df <- read.csv('Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv')
perc_df$correct_num <- ifelse(perc_df$correct == "True", 1, 0)
perc_df$x_raw <- ifelse(perc_df$staircase == 2, perc_df$param1, perc_df$param2)
perc_df <- perc_df[perc_df$x_raw > 0,]
perc_df$x <- log(perc_df$x_raw) # log transform to intensity
perc_df$x <- ave(perc_df$x, perc_df$task_name, FUN = function(v) as.numeric(scale(v))) # standardize

```

```{r}
# Exclude (subject, task) cells that is a >4SD outlier or  has a non-converged staircase
clean_scores    <- read.csv('Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv')
clean_scores$id <- as.character(clean_scores$id)
excluded_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perc_tasks, function(t) {
  bad_ids <- clean_scores$id[is.na(clean_scores[[t]])]
  if (length(bad_ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(id = bad_ids, task_name = t, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

perc_df$id       <- as.character(perc_df$id)
perc_df$cell_key <- paste(perc_df$id, perc_df$task_name, sep = "_") # create a temporally column to help deletion
excluded_keys    <- paste(excluded_cells$id, excluded_cells$task_name, sep = "_") # Match key to the temporally column
perc_df <- subset(perc_df, !(cell_key %in% excluded_keys))
perc_df$cell_key <- NULL

# map subject id and task name to vectors
ids     <- sort(unique(perc_df$id))
id_map  <- setNames(seq_along(ids), ids)
task_map <- setNames(seq_along(perc_tasks), perc_tasks)
perc_df$id_idx   <- id_map[perc_df$id]
perc_df$task_idx <- task_map[perc_df$task_name]
n_subj  <- length(ids)
```

```{r}
# aggregate Bernoulli trials -> Binomial counts to fasten the sampling
agg_list <- split(perc_df, list(perc_df$id_idx, perc_df$task_idx, perc_df$x), drop = TRUE)
agg_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(agg_list, function(d) {
  data.frame(id_idx = d$id_idx[1], task_idx = d$task_idx[1], x = d$x[1], k = sum(d$correct_num), n = nrow(d))
}))

# standardize the cognitive scores
cog        <- read.csv('Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv')
cog$id     <- as.character(cog$id)
cog   <- reshape(cog, idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide") 
names(cog) <- gsub("^score\\.", "", names(cog))
cog[,cog_tasks] = -scale(cog[,cog_tasks])
cog <- as.matrix(cog[match(ids, cog$id), cog_tasks])
rownames(cog) <- ids
```

```{r}
# prepare Stan data
stan_data <- list(
  N       = nrow(agg_df),
  I       = n_subj,
  J       = n_perc_task,
  C       = n_cog_task,
  T       = n_task,
  id      = agg_df$id_idx,
  task    = agg_df$task_idx,
  s       = agg_df$x,
  k       = agg_df$k,
  ntrials = agg_df$n,
  cog     = cog,
  nu0     = n_task + 2, 
  tau     = 0.01          # noise is very small for cognitive data so that the data will just be itself
)

# init using MLE
mle_theta <- matrix(NA, n_subj, n_perc_task, dimnames = list(ids, perc_tasks))
mle_beta  <- setNames(numeric(n_perc_task), perc_tasks)
for (t in seq_along(perc_tasks)) {
  task <- perc_tasks[t]
  sub  <- subset(perc_df, task_name == task)
  sub$id <- factor(sub$id, levels = ids)
  fit_glm <- glm(correct_num ~ 0 + id + x, data = sub, family = binomial(link = "probit"))
  b_x  <- coef(fit_glm)["x"]; beta <- -b_x
  a    <- coef(fit_glm)[grepl("^id", names(coef(fit_glm)))]
  names(a) <- sub("^id", "", names(a))
  mle_theta[names(a), task] <- a / beta
  mle_beta[task] <- beta
}
for (t in perc_tasks) mle_theta[is.na(mle_theta[, t]), t] <- mean(mle_theta[, t], na.rm = TRUE)
mu_init <- c(colMeans(mle_theta), colMeans(cog))
xi_init <- c(apply(mle_theta, 2, sd), apply(cog, 2, sd))
raw_perc_init <- sweep(sweep(mle_theta, 2, mu_init[1:n_perc_task], "-"), 2, xi_init[1:n_perc_task], "/")
raw_cog_init  <- sweep(sweep(cog, 2, mu_init[(n_perc_task+1):n_task], "-"), 2, xi_init[(n_perc_task+1):n_task], "/")
raw_init <- cbind(raw_perc_init, raw_cog_init)
init_fn <- function() {
  list(
    mu = as.numeric(mu_init), beta = as.numeric(mle_beta), sigma = as.numeric(xi_init),
    Sigma_raw = diag(n_task),
    raw = raw_init + matrix(rnorm(n_subj * n_task, 0, 0.02), n_subj, n_task)
  )
}

# run model
mod <- stan_model("Model/model.stan")
fit <- sampling(mod, data = stan_data, chains = 3, cores = 3, iter = 5000, warmup = 2000, init = init_fn)

# Diagnostics
summ <- summary(fit, pars = c("mu", "beta", "sigma_theta", "Omega"))$summary
cat("Max Rhat overall: ", max(summ[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Min n_eff overall:", min(summ[, "n_eff"], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
saveRDS(fit, "Data/summary/trace.rds")
```

Model Structure
$$
\begin{aligned}
\theta_{i,\cdot} &\sim \mathcal{N}\!\big(\boldsymbol\mu,\; \Sigma\big), & i &= 1,\dots,I \\[6pt]
y_{i,j,k} &\sim \text{Bernoulli}\big(p_{i,j,k}\big), \quad p_{i,j,k} = \Phi\Big(\beta_{j}\,\big(\theta_{i,j} - s_{i,j,k}\big)\Big), & j &=1,\dots,J,\;\; k=1,\dots,K \\[6pt]
\text{cog}_{i,c} &\sim \mathcal{N}\big(\theta_{i,\,J+c},\; \tau^2\big), & c &=1,\dots,C \\[6pt]
\mu_j &\sim \mathcal{N}(0, 5), & j &=1,\dots,T \\[6pt]
\beta_j &\sim \mathcal{N}(0, 5), & j &=1,\dots,J \\[6pt]
\Sigma &= D\Sigma_{\text{raw}}D, & D &= \text{diag}(\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_T) \\[6pt]
\sigma_j &\sim \text{Half-}t_{3}(0,\, 2.5), & j &=1,\dots,T \\[6pt]
\Sigma &\sim \text{Inverse-Wishart}(\nu_0,\, S_0), & S_0 &= I_T
\end{aligned}
$$



```{r}
# read rds, extract theta and Omega and save both
library(corrplot)
fit <- readRDS("Data/summary/trace.rds")
all_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi","OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")

# subject x task score matrix (theta posterior mean)
theta_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "theta")$theta   # [iter, n_subj, n_task]
theta_mean  <- apply(theta_draws, c(2, 3), mean)
colnames(theta_mean) <- all_tasks
write.csv(theta_mean, "Data/summary/theta.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# correlation matrix 
omega_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "Omega")$Omega   # [iter, n_task, n_task]
corr <- apply(omega_draws, c(2, 3), mean)
dimnames(corr) <- list(all_tasks, all_tasks)
write.csv(corr, "Data/summary/corr.csv")

# reorder
stim_order <- c("TLetter", "SLetter", "TGabor", "SGabor", "TPi", "SPi",
                "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
corr_ordered <- corr[stim_order, stim_order]
# plot
corrplot(corr_ordered, method = "color", mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), tl.col = "black", tl.cex = 0.8)
```

```{r}
library(rstan)
fit <- readRDS("Data/summary/trace.rds")
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
all_tasks  <- c(perc_tasks, cog_tasks)

beta_summ  <- summary(fit, pars = "beta")$summary
sigma_summ <- summary(fit, pars = "sigma_theta")$summary
rownames(beta_summ)  <- perc_tasks
rownames(sigma_summ) <- all_tasks

cat("beta\n")
print(round(beta_summ[, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")], 3))
cat("sigma\n")
print(round(sigma_summ[, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")], 3))

beta_df  <- data.frame(task = perc_tasks, beta_summ, row.names = NULL)
sigma_df <- data.frame(task = all_tasks, sigma_summ, row.names = NULL)
write.csv(beta_df,  "Data/summary/beta.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sigma_df, "Data/summary/sigma.csv", row.names = FALSE)

beta_draws  <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "beta")$beta
colnames(beta_draws) <- perc_tasks
write.csv(beta_draws, "Data/summary/beta.csv", row.names = FALSE)
sigma_draws <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "sigma_theta")$sigma_theta
colnames(sigma_draws) <- all_tasks
write.csv(sigma_draws, "Data/summary/sigma.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
